record.question: Where is the Global Centre for Security and Counter Terrorism being established?
record.explanation: Answer C: Jaipur. Jaipur is the location of the Sardar Patel Global Centre for Security, Counter Terrorism and Anti Insurgency. The Home Ministry’s original report lists assistance to Rajasthan for its establishment at Jaipur under 2017–20 infrastructure funding. Historical/source note: Historical funded establishment project at Jaipur; not a claim that a completed centre was already operational in 2017. Reference: https://www.mha.gov.in/web/sites/default/files/AnnualReport_18_19.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
